Hickut was once standing on the banks of the river, but its waters became vapor during the Cataclysm. Now the riverbed is but a canyon on Xadagan, and memories of the boats carved of black wood, drifting along to the whispers of crocodile gods, remain instead of the flotillas of old.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

Lost and forgotten in the Astral, their bodies remained almost undamaged thanks to their meteorite shells, and now, their prayers to the Servants of Tensess sound like the clattering of swords. Today, they are the final shield between Sarnaut and the void.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

Mages who used their minds to touch life in alien worlds eventually attracted the attention of these worlds. Something alien entered their bodies and minds using the established connection - through time and unimaginable space.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Outraged by the numerous violations during tournaments, these guardsmen refused to participate in them for some time, deciding to conduct special military campaigns against those who sullied their good names.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Druids were much more powerful in the old era than they are now. These hermits lived in the deep forests, making their own laws and rejecting the authority of states, even that of the Xadaganian Empire.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Once a permanent connection was established between Sarnaut and Eden, the Star Trail became a place where travelers encountered something new all the time. One of their discoveries was a complete set of Star Knight armor.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Summer 2022 ticket at the start of the event.

Even before the first followers of Tensess created the Church, there were noble knights and wise hermit monks in Sarnaut. They were among the first to accept his Gift, and they formed the organization we know today.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Summer 2023 ticket at the start of the event.

One inquisitor named Ambrose always served the Church of Light with devotion, and his brutal methods of exterminating heretics made him a feared symbol of the Inquisition. However, after his death his soul refused to leave the world of the living due to his deep faith.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

In ancient times, when the land was shrouded in darkness and fear, and the Aro tribes lived in the northern swamplands, there lived a great hero named Velikogor, whose shoulders were wider than an oak tree and whose height exceeded five yards. He was the chosen protector of his people and bravely fought the ancient dragons that threatened the world.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

In ancient times there lived a cunning archer named Fedot. One day while hunting in the forest, he came across a magical bird that could transform into a beautiful bird maiden. Fascinated by her beauty and charm, Fedot decided to take her home.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

A powerful sorcerer named Khitr sought knowledge of the magical sciences. He went to distant lands where the great elven magister Elleken lived. The wise and powerful Elleken accepted Khitr as a student. Under his guidance, the Kanian delved into the secrets of magic, striving for perfection.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

A prankster named Gennady was known on the tropical beach for his pranks and playing practical jokes on other visitors. One day he played a funny prank by painting all the beach umbrellas bright neon colors, drawing the attention of all the vacationers.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The powerful necromancer Chernoved was the one who raised the Marksmen from the dead. His black magic allowed them to regain some semblance of life and will. He saw them not just as warriors, but as tools for his own purposes - protecting Kania and destroying the traitor Nezeb.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

A terrible battle broke out on the fields between the troops of Kania and the tribes of Ugra led by the traitor Nezeb. In the front ranks stood brave Marksmen with harquebuses, ready to join the fight. Their shots were accurate, their hearts were burning with determination to win.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Ancient Legends ticket at the start of the event.

When the era of astral navigation began, the society of the old states like Kania, Xadagan or the Elven Houses changed greatly. Transporting goods through portals used to be unprofitable - only particularly valuable cargo was moved that way. But with the help of ships, trade between allods became possible.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The history of the elves can be divided into many stages - this tradition dates back to Zayan. Very little is known about the initial stage, when the kingdom was just formed and power belonged to the House of Ollathar. The subsequent period, when power passed to the House of Velund, can tell us more.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Much has changed under Hirkalla's rule. Those who died returned from oblivion, the allods were filled with the ghosts of those who once lived. However, few of them were able to truly resurrect. It was mostly those who were healthy and rich during their lifetime, their Spark full of vitality.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Ominous legends surround the inhabitants of the mysterious Maelstrom, a powerful astral whirlpool in the depths of distant sectors. According to rumors, they worship the astral plane itself, considering it the embryo of a future god.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Even though the power of Tep, who become a personified God of Death, is great, many of his followers have begun doubting Tep's true intentions - and the notion that conquering worlds can bring them happiness. Are they truly ready to cast the world unto absolute predestination while being aware that their fates might be predetermined, or should they trust the infinite possibilities of true randomness of chance?

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Cape of the Path of Tep Follower

description.en:
The Keepers have finally found Tep's tracks as he set out to get to Xadagan allod in his effort to ruin Nefer Ur's plans. The Keepers are preparing for savage battle, intending to do that which they were trained for: strike down the Darkness and vanquish Tep. Once the world is rid of his evil acts, they would again become the keepers of harmony, capable of defending Sarnaut against any threats.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Hickut's Legacy ticket at the start of the event.

name.en: Cape of the Keepers of the Forgotten Temple

description.en:
Reference from the Jeb-net: the Sekhem subculture attracts the Arisen who strive for self-expression and finding thei own individuality. Unique clothing style and music are their venues for finding their own voice and creating the communities where they can be themselves.

Can be received from Sarang Pkhuta on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Rutes are a subculture that strives for self-expression through unusual lifestyles and art. Their motivation is to stand out from the mass culture and show their uniqueness through fashion, music and creative arts.

Can be received from Sarbaz Keket on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Yahkeb subculture attracts the youth that prizes sincere expression of feelings and emotions. Through music, style and poetry, the followers of this subculture find ways of communing with others espousing similar kinds of experiences.

Can be received from Yaver Leila on Xadagan.

The Tekyan people have a legend about mysterious shapeshifters who can separate their heads from their bodies at night and use their ears as wings. In everyday life, they often live unnoticed and can have human spouses. They say that one of them was caught and put in a cage, so now it's harmless.

Source: .

When the liberator warriors finally freed their lands from enemies, they were regarded as heroes. Their fame spread throughout the land, and they became a symbol of hope and freedom for all who lived under foreign oppression. They were immortalized in history and became legends.

Source: Forging Ahead Collector's Edition.

The Empire's test drivers are known for their passion for speed and technology. They all went through tough tests to become proud representatives of their great country. They show their bravery on the track, overcoming all obstacles and risking their lives for the sake of science and progress.

Source: Imperial Grandeur Collector's Edition.

The huge pyramid over Sar-Iram, assembled by the engineers of the Arisen Zem, is the visible incarnation of the Wireframe. But it is, in fact, only a small part of a huge complex that makes use of the entire allod's resources.

Source: Eternal Struggle Collector's Edition.

The ancient forests of Irene were full of various insects which delighted the young Elves who admired by the richness of colors and shapes. This gave rise to many traditions and celebrations at the onset of spring.

Source: Miraculous Metamorphoses Collector's Edition.

The Empire banned their rituals, but the Great Trees of Lugna become their allies. Cones fall from the pine trees, knocking soldiers out, and roots grab the ankles of those who dare to raise their swords against the priestesses. Even the air here is hostile to those who are plotting evil deeds - and the sticky resin binds the bodies of enemies.

Source: Spring's Tune Collector's Edition.

Candy Kingdom is the friendliest kingdom of Sarnaut. Why fight enemies if you can treat them to the most delicious sweets and desserts? Every resident of the kingdom is also its guard, and they always carry a bit of sweet joy with them.

Source:  Surprise Cake Collector's Edition.

After returning from Eden, the inhabitants of Sarnaut began to actively discuss the All-Mother's new teachings preached by the Children. Former soldiers of the League and the Empire were inspired by the idea of love and peace. Some began to doubt the need for conflicts and wars, believing in the possibility of living in harmony with the surrounding world.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Source: Wild Party Collector's Edition.

How many wars would all these great heroes have won if they fought on an empty stomach? This is what all the famous chefs think, as warriors eat their meals between battles.

Source: Great Feast Prophetic Card.

On forgotten allods lost in the distant astral plane, lived warrior monks who combined the power of the sword and their faith in the Light. They dedicated their lives to serving it and protecting the world from the dark forces threatening the peace in all of Sarnaut. One day, when the skies darkened with ominous clouds, their wise abbot gathered all the warriors and told them of the impending threat - an army of shadows that sought to devour this world. Inspired by his speech, the monks swore to use their faith as a weapon against evil.

Source: Holy Army Prophetic Card.

There are mysterious tales of a golden key which, according to legend, can open any door. It was kept by a special group of people who protected this artifact from falling into the wrong hands.

Source: New Year's Overture Prophetic Card.

Every craftsman on the island of artisans had their own secret, handed down from one generation to the next. The old, long-bearded blacksmith was forging swords and hammers so durable that they were capable of breaking stone. And the wise old lady was weaving wonderful fabrics - shimmering like the starlit sky. There was no quarrel and miscommunication on the island: all the people lived in harmony and helped one another, for each of their handiworks was filled with love and warmth.

Source: Elegant Patterns Prophetic Card.

The story behind this contraption is simple: once upon a time, a group of experienced lifeguards went to a tropical resort to ensure the safety of tourists on the beach. These heroes were known for their professionalism and courage, and their goal was to make each guest's stay at the resort unforgettable. They did their job - and this item, accidentally forgotten by them, has remained here as a memento ever since.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

When the earth was shattered into allods, and Tep's Pyramids faded away into the all-consuming Astral, the resurrected Arisen heard a voice amid the rumbling of Astral winds. It was calling out not to the stars - for here, there are none - but to the seas of Aether where the waves shimmer like the tears of forgotten spirits.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

The ancient knights of the Allods, the brave warriors of Tensess, swore to safeguard the ruins of Kania's capital - the city of Quator, sundered by the Cataclysm. Their armor shines with astral steel, woven with the magic of Light, and their hearts blaze with loyalty to the unforgotten testament: not even death breaks their service.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

Before the cataclysm, there were many different states. Among them were the mysterious kingdoms of the South which joined Nezeb's Empire. Many of them had their own unique magic supported by their gods.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

One of the main enemies of the druids was the Order of the Sun, created back in the time of the first Valirs. This order of chivalry devoted itself to the fight against superstition as well as witches and sorcerers, and for some reason druids were lumped in with them. However, when only one banner returned from the military campaign in the forest, the knights stopped trying to eliminate them.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

One of the new kingdoms, Everia was located in the lands of the Orcs and was inhabited by people from Kania and Xadagan who did not have enough space in their native lands. Everia was a sunny country with access to the warm sea, and joy reigned there. However, its existence was overshadowed by the claims of the Kingdom of Tlavia which wanted to annex these lands.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

When Aidenus became a Great Mage and established the Department of Sword and Fire, some of its wards took an interest in combat magic. While they were warriors in essence, they were able to learn certain fire spells. Thus the Order of the Sun was founded, forming the basis of the first Knights and Paladins.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The Inquisitor, now one of the undead he had previously fought, discovered that the world was inhabited by other kinds of undead - vicious ghouls and wights he could now sense from a great distance. He realized that his new purpose was to fight these dark forces and protect the living.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Wanting to drive away one of the fire serpents, Velikogor gathered brave heroes and went in search of the dragon's lair. The battle was fierce, but Velikogor and his troops were able to win, driving the evil dragon out of the lands of the Aro people.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

However, over time Khitr began to envy the teacher and covet his power. He deceived Elleken and stole his ancient spell books. Even though he did not possess a full understanding of the magical formulas, Khitr decided to try one of the most powerful spells.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

He then staged a fake "theft" of his own surfing gear, causing the entire beach community to join in a mass search while the prankster watched from afar, laughing until he cried.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The enemy was vicious, but the Marksmen did not falter. Their harquebuses kept firing, repelling the attacks of the Ugra tribes. The Marksmen were a stone wall protecting their land and their people.
Their spirit was unwavering, and their determination was insurmountable.
Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Ancient Legends ticket at the start of the event.

Tlavia was a young and predatory state that entered the arena of history in the fourth millennium of the old era. The power in it was divided between humans and elves, and the ruling dynasty was the descendants of both peoples. The colors of the Tlavian flag are magenta and cyan, and for a long time this flag struck terror into the hearts of the nobles of Kania and Xadagan.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The astral plane is full of dangers - storms, predatory astral creatures, and even pirates. But there are also brave astral captains - those who risk their lives to transport essential goods from one allod to another. They carry fabrics, device parts, food, and even weekly newspapers!

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The powerful family of Velund was known for their skill in crafting armor and weapons. They were the first to discover methods of enchanting metals and weaving intricate spells into ordinary objects.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

It is surprising how the revived nobility got used to the current world so quickly. There were things they didn't like, of course. The noble families of old Kania were puzzled by the extent of power held by the universally elected Governors and the Church.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Pirates do not recognize any authority over themselves, save for their captain's. This is how it has been since ancient times. But they still coordinate their actions somehow. According to rumors, they have a leader, someone authoritative enough to keep these people in line.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Kanian nobility was the bulwark of the state and loyal defenders of the Valir throne. But after Nezeb's conquests many of those nobles ended up in the territories under his control. However, the Xadaganian Emperor did not strip them of their power, choosing to preserve their authority in the conquered lands. An example of such a union was the dynasty of kings of Yazes.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Khoremheb lived in the ancient Hickut when Tep's Plague devastated his city, taking a great many lives - including his. After his death, the body was embalmed and placed inside the tomb - and it remained there in centuries-long repose. But a time has come when the mysterious Spark Energy, released from Tep's Pyramids when they were destroyed, brought Khoremheb back to life.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Long ago in ancient Hickut, a priest called Anempekht served the Gods, performing daily rituals and prayers - until the plague ravaged his city. He fell victim to the malady, leaving behind but a silent shadow that was drawn into the depths of the Pyramid. When his soul departed the body, he felt the world around him become engulfed in darkness, and all that he ever knew vanished.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Mask of the Priest of Forgotten Gods

description.en:
In ancient Hickut, the servant of the Nih cult named Ontuntakhm was eagerly partaking in dark rituals, making sacrifices and sowing fear among the people. His deeds of evil continued until the plague that decimated the populace of his home city killed him as well. As he lay dying, Ontuntakhm realized that his power over the victims was no good for saving him from his own demise.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

A noble warrior by the name Nephersen lived in ancient Hickut, serving Peraach and defending his lands against enemies. His bravery and skill in combat made him respected and glorified by the people. However, when returning from a victorious campaign, Nephersen was faced with the horrible plague that stole his life, leaving behind only legends of his feats.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The necromancer Tep, overcome with lust for power, unleashed magical plague upon his people, destroying millions of lives. As a result of his atrocities, he gained immortality, becoming the master of the dead and the lord of shadows. However, despite all his power, he yearned to share his triumph with someone else, so he needed faithful followers who would be ready to make his grand ambitions a reality.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Crown of the Path of Tep Follower

description.en:
Reference from the Jeb-net: the Rute subculture is formed chiefly by the influence of various currents of music, like Zem Punk, Jeb Rock, Astrometal, etc. Music becomes not just a venue of expression, but also a primary source of inspiration, which is conducive to the development of their aesthetics and ideology.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Sekhem aesthetic, permeated with somber themes, gives adequate space for freely expressing sadness, solitude and depression, which helps the followers of this subculture in dealing with personal challenges.

Can be received from Sarang Pkhuta on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: many Rutes choose this path as a form of protesting against societal norms and stereotypes. They renounce homogenity and strive to create a space where diversity and originality are valued, allowing anyone to be their own self.

Can be received from Sarbaz Keket on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the culture of Yahkeb emphasizes the importance of emotional vulnerability as a way of overcoming the suffering within. Their lyrical songs and the characteristic style of clothing allow the followers of this subculture to freely speak of their emotional experiences while finding support from like-minded individuals.

Can be received from Yaver Leila on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Kheni subculture unites the Arisen dedicated to particular artists, genres or currents of music. It is defined by vivid expressions of their passion by attending concerts, collecting the paraphernalia and socializing with those of like mind.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Kahutean subculture involves the Arisen whose work is physical labor in production facilities, and it entails specific traditions, style of communication and values, such as comradeship and labor ethics.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Khemetean subculture brings together the Arisen following the aesthetics and lifestyles associated with beauty, fashion and luxury, often reflecting the ideals of glamour connected to the world of creativity and lofty style.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Ahahutean subculture is the union of the Arisen who have gone through tribulations together. It is characterized by the deep feeling of comradeship, respect for discipline and the desire to support each other after the adventuring is over.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Penayeter subculture is the association of the Arisen who broadcast their gaming sessions, creative process or even daily lives in realtime via jeb platforms, and actively communicate with their audience.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Khud subculture brings together the Arisen who possess considerable financial resources. Their primary characteristic is seeking luxurious lifestyles, exclusive services and high social status.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Khesuti subculture includes a group of Arisen who accentuate their looks, the fashionable style and the strive for physical attractiveness, often expressing their interests through fashion, sport and social media.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Resouter subculture brings together the Arisen actively partaking in night life, attending clubs, parties and music events to find social interaction and entertainment.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Metean subculture calls together the Arisen sharing optimistic outlook, dedicated to promoting positivity and creating inspirational atmosphere through communication, creativity and various practices of personal growth.

Can be obtained on Xadagan by using .

Reference from the Jeb-net: archaeologists and scientists often collaborate with historians of other races to integrate distinct approaches to studying artifacts and contexts of excavations. They aim to pass on the knowldge of ancient civilizations both to the broad audience and to the future generations, which helps with fostering respect to historical heritage and the understanding of its importance for modernity.

Can be received from Sarang Zuka on Xadagan.

Long ago, when Sarnaut was plunged into the darkness of war, people suffered from merciless enemies who seized their lands and enslaved people. But among them were those who did not want to live under foreign oppression. They called upon the forces of the great Empire to fight with them for their freedom.

Source: Forging Ahead Collector's Edition.

The Empire has exiled the shamans who rejected its laws, and the League's druids fled, salvaging the sacred seeds. On Lugna, where the trees obscure the skies, they became the Sylvans - those whose horns wove together the sky and the earth while praying to the great Goddess who exists since the beginning of all.

Source: Spring's Tune Collector's Edition.

Sarnaut was engulfed in unrest due to the emergence of a new movement based on the teachings of the All-Mother. The inhabitants of Allods began to exchange ideas and discuss how to change their lives in accordance with the principles of love and peace. Many decided to reconsider their values and look at the world from a new perspective.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Source: Wild Party Collector's Edition.

All wearers of the famous chef's hat protect its secret. Some believe that a mysterious assistant is hidden in it, whispering recipes to the cook.

Source: Great Feast Prophetic Card.

Armed with prayers and sacred symbols, the warrior monks set out into the heart of the dark forest, the Shadow Woods, where creatures of darkness dwelled. Every step along this gloomy path reminded them of their mission - to protect the innocent and restore the true faith. In the forest they encountered terrible monsters, but their faith gave them strength. With each battle, the monks became more confident in their faith, their hearts filled with light, and their swords shone like the sun.

Source: Holy Army Prophetic Card.

In the distant blue Astral sea, beyond seven mountains and nine rivers, was the magical island of the folk craftsmen who arrived here from Kania, a long time ago. Kind experts in their crafts lived there - they knew neither the labors of the factory nor gold, but created miracles with their own hands. Every day they gathered on the verdant glade where the spirits of craftsmanship inspired them to create unique items. They sewed, they wove, they cut and they sculpted - and each of their creations could have become a fairytale in its own right.

Source: Elegant Patterns Prophetic Card.

Ordinary workers, bureaucrats and officials who decided to escape the chaos of endless paperwork and incompetent bosses. They took all their money and went to the tropical resort. After they boarded the cruise ship, they dreamed of palm trees, turquoise water and sandy beaches where you can forget about your worries and relax.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

The story goes that the first day at work for the lifeguards began just after sunrise. They held a training session to make sure everyone was in top physical shape and ready for any challenge. Then these beautiful girls and boys set up their base on the beach and began patrolling the shoreline, making sure no one on vacation got into trouble.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

Yarr! For a long time, pirates sailed the astral seas, hunting for treasures and fighting enemies. But after a difficult journey, they finally decided to relax and enjoy the tranquility of the tropical resort, because even pirates get tired of robbing poor travelers.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

Harry the Sun Crab always dreamed of seeing the ocean. One day he went on an exciting journey to the seashore. The exciting sound of the surf filled his heart with joy, and Harry realized that his dream had finally come true.

Source: Beach Cheer Collector's Edition.

One day a young pioneer girl named Nastenka, while walking outside the pioneer camp, came across a giant pumpkin growing in an abandoned greenhouse. This wonderful pumpkin glowed golden and enticed her with its sweet aroma. Nastenka, forgetting all the warnings, began to devour its juicy pulp, not realizing that with each bite something terrible was happening to her. The next morning, the pioneers were horrified when they saw Nastenka - her head was now an ugly pumpkin with a smiling mouth and evil eyes. From then on, the girl with the pumpkin head became a scary story that was told to everyone who came to the pioneer camp.

Source: .

A charming snake from the forests of Lugna. After the release of Ambrosia on Suslanger, the local animals began to acquire the properties of plant symbiosis.

Source: «Spring Winds» Collector's Edition.

They were building ships out of their ancestors' shields and the charred wooden beams of palaces. Sails saturated with the ashes of Xadagan were following the flows of Astral, and they had no maps - only the songs of old pilots, songs that became prayers against the eternal silence.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

They can be encountered in the depths of Astral seas, where only shadows of demons flicker through the cracks of reality. Their ghostly ships, created by elves back in the times of the wars for Kirah, carry the knights through the mists of Astral, and their blades cleave the darkness - like the swords of the warriors of Tensess once did.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

One of the commandants of the astral posts managed to withstand a siege of pirates for three months. The siege was led by the famous pirates Anna Bonina and Maria Ridina. He lost most of his people but did not surrender the post entrusted to him.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

At some point, the Order of the Crimson Wrath became convinced that only enemies surrounded it. Its members left the boundaries of the existing states and retired to their own fortress in the astral plane. However, soon they started fighting among themselves.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The hot lands of the south have always been home to a wide variety of superstitions. Cut off from the northern part of the continent by deserts and impenetrable jungles, they became a place where a multitude of small deities lived, seeking worship from savages.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The druids did not form any single state - they lived in separate circles of the Magi which included hermits who lived within the bounds of the same forest. The most powerful among them was the Bear Circle which occupied the northern forests. That was where the Aro tribes originated.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Once upon a time, the lands of Everia were not inhabited - the coastal steppes were the domain of nomadic orcs and goblins. However, after several wars with Kania, the Orcs lost a great number of people and were forced to retreat. Complex family ties connect the Elven Houses of Everia and the royal dynasties of Irene. The nobles who moved here are mired in endless disputes about which family should rule.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

A hundred years ago, no one could have thought that the current inhabitants of Sarnaut would have the opportunity to go to a distant tropical atoll at any time of the summer! The summer resort became a place where the most diverse creatures of Sarnaut can meet and enjoy the sun and gentle waves! Nothing unites like having fun together!

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Astral sailors often talk about ghost ships, and there are many explanations for this. The currents or winds of the Astral itself carry ancient fragments which somehow have not fallen apart. Besides, there are mirages that can come to life if you believe in them.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Orders have always been strong on the Forox allod, and they included the knight Brian who was a loyal ally of Danas. Thanks to the Great Mage Aidenus's patronage, the Orders were able to protect Forox from evil.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Clad in armor and armed with a sacred sword, the Inquisitor set out on a journey through peaceful villages and dark forests, rooting out the evil undead. His appearance became a legend among ordinary people who began to call him the "Light Inquisitor".

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Then a second dragon with poisonous breath rose from its lair, threatening to destroy everything in its path. Velikogor and his warriors once again stepped up to protect their people, facing the dragon in a brutal battle.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Fedot was forced to carry out the king's order to save his beloved. He began to work for the king as his personal archer, performing various tasks. At the same time, he always tried to find ways to evade the most dangerous assignments.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

But the spell's misuse led to unexpected consequences: Khitr found himself on the surface of the moon. He was shocked by his mistake and desperately tried to find a way to return home. Alone and cut off from the world, he realized the value of his teacher's lessons.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

In a new battle with the Xadaganians, the revived Marksmen once again fought to protect Kania. Their shots struck true, their hearts were colder than ice. Under the leadership of the necromancer, they repelled the enemy's onslaught once again, turning the tide of battle.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The battle was so fierce that the Marksmen could not withstand the onslaught of the enemy. They all fell on the battlefield, their harquebuses fell silent, their hearts stopped beating. But their feat did not go unnoticed, their souls remained forever connected to this place.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Ancient Legends ticket at the start of the event.

Once upon a time, the Miracle Theater secretly visited Olma. They were greatly impressed by what they saw. Their repertoire now includes a tragedy about wandering Pridens who were expelled from their homeland and found shelter on one of the elven allods.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Darkness is a natural part of existence, and this truth is shared by all adepts of demonic cults. Demons are just a tool, and whether Sarnaut should be saved or destroyed is up to us to decide. That's the Demonologists' creed.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Summer 2022 ticket at the start of the event.

Darkness dominates Sarnaut, and now we face creatures that do not belong in this world. There is a rumor about terrifying husks, mistresses of nightmares, who came here at the summons of Hirkalla.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Many captains die with their ships. Enchanted and consecrated by priests, the ship's infirmary may be ready to resurrect the fallen crew in case of trouble, but once the ship sinks, rescue will be impossible. Only a few have an expensive emergency teleport that can take you to your home allod.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Their wealth and influence allowed them to overtake other Houses, such as Moran or Glaen, when the last king Ollathar died after being attacked by dragons. The Velunds did a lot to protect Irene from the attacks of fire-breathing giants; it was their barrier that limited the dragons' ability to hunt elves in the northwestern forests.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

However, the nobility of the Old Era consists of more than just spoiled parasites and sybarites. After all, many of them are experienced warriors, knights, and guards - the support of the Valir dynasty's throne.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

None of the living inhabitants of the allods have ever entered Maelstrom and returned to tell the tale. However, pirates from the dark sector often pick up slaves and take them to their home.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Anempekht suddenly awoke in a bustling megalopolis where pyramids of iron pierced the clouds, and the now resurrected Arisen were going about their daily business. He was surprised by the absence of the gods and the rituals that once made the essence of his life. Looking for answers, the priest started studying philosophy and science - and realized the his gods were just figments of imagination.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Cloak of the Priest of Forgotten Gods

description.en:
Tep started looking for those who might become his disciples, paying particular attention to the people who were rejected by society, or have lost everything. He promised them power and greatness, luring them in with promises of might and immortality. Each of his followers was bound with dark magic, which made them ideal candidates to carry forth his vision and plans.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Cloak of the Path of Tep Follower

description.en:
Millennia later, in the modern world, an Archaeologist historian chanced upon an ancient Pyramid, knowing nothing of its true nature - and destroyed the crystal. The souls and bodies of the Keepers were liberated, they regained their powers and abilities. Upon realizing that the world has been thrown into the Astral's chaos and evil has risen again, they swore vengeance upon Tep for his treachery.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Hickut's Legacy ticket at the start of the event.

name.en: Doublet of the Keepers of the Forgotten Temple

description.en:
Reference from the Jeb-net: Sekhems are often creatively-minded individuals who use their affiliation with this subculture to unleash their potential for arts. Music, poetry and visual oeuvre become vehicles for self-expression and inspiration, as well as for communing with other creators.

Can be received from Sarang Pkhuta on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Rute subculture actively encourages experimentation in music, visual arts and other forms of creativity. This drive for innovation allows them to express themselves and explore new ideas, which makes this culture a dynamic and constantly evolving one.

Can be received from Sarbaz Keket on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: many of those in the Yahkeb subculture use art as a method of expressing themselves and processing personal experiences. Music, visual arts and poetry become avenues for exhibiting their emotions and making meaningful connections with others.

Can be received from Yaver Leila on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: one of the most promising projects by the Zem Arisen is the voyage to Sarnaut's surviving natural satellite - the moon that is theorised to possess powerful magical properties.

Can be received from Sarang Krem on Xadagan.

The legacy of the liberator warriors lives on to this day. Their battles and victories inspire new generations who continue to fight for their rights and freedoms and defend their lands from enemies. The current generations know that if they fight with the same courage and determination as the liberators, they will also win and become heroes of their people.

Source: Forging Ahead Collector's Edition.

Thanks to their dedication and courage, test drivers have achieved incredible results in the world of high-speed technology. Their names have become legendary, and their achievements are recognized throughout the world. They have become symbols of courage and pride for their country, inspiring other nations with their skill and determination.

Source: Imperial Grandeur Collector's Edition.

When the Gates to other worlds opened, many residents of Sarnaut went on long journeys. These people came back to the new capital of Jigran, bringing with them technologies collected from all over the universe. Some call them scavengers, but they call themselves worldwalkers.

Source: City Legend Collector's Edition.

They mark the roads of the Goddess with rings of sacred pines, and magical runes of the Moon are inscribed on the bark of these trees. Under the three crescent moons, the sylvans dance, weaving branches into arches - portals through which the spirits of the allods may bring news of the free lands.

Source: Spring's Tune Collector's Edition.

A crunchy waffle, gummies, whipped cream - what else could you need for a perfect outfit? The residents of the Candy Kingdom agree. This attire is full of candy fashion style.

Source: Collector's Edition Surprise Cake.

Some of the people of Sarnaut went to the Tropical Atoll to relax and reflect on the meaning of life. Here they discovered new aspects of existence that had previously seemed hidden to them. Vacation at the summer resort became a time of deep reflections on their place in this world.

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Source: Wild Party Collector's Edition.

Was it by accident that the Ambrosia endowed this attire with incredible powers? The ship that was transporting anniversary costumes to the Eclipse was caught in a storm that started after the eruption of Ambrosia on Suslanger. That was why the delivery was delayed for a week, and the costumes were transformed by the mysterious matter.

Received during the celebration of the Twelfth Anniversary of Allods Online.

Light but durable armor decorated with gold thread and rubies. The details indicate the high status of the governor of the Great Nezeb - that he is truly worthy of ruling the province entrusted to him (with fire, sword and whip, he will inspire respect for the supreme power!).

Source: Nezeb's Legacy Prophetic Card.

After Cosmos became the first Great Mage of the Aoidoi, more and more warriors were born in the Well of Souls. These new residents of Polis quickly formed real legions which now accept anyone who wishes to fight under the banner of the Dominus of Creation.

Source: Emerald Oasis Prophetic Card.

At the day's most important time, when the sun is especially bright, the craftsmen assembled under a great oak - the tree whose roots delved deep into the earth, and its branches touched the sky. Once there, these people exchanged their experiences and ideas, discussed their creations and took inspiration in each other. Each had their own tools of the trade in hand - cutters, threads, paints or clay pots - and every small piece they wrought was imbued with their soul's strength.

Source: Elegant Patterns Prophetic Card.

Recent events have undermined the authority of the Conclave of Great Mages, and many sorcerers are pursuing their own paths now. Today's sorcerers do not differentiate between the magic of the elements, mind, death, and even the Astral: they boldly mix curses and spells that affect the very existence.

Source: Arcana of Rebirth Prophetic Card.

Upon arriving at the resort, the vacationing workers were amazed by the beauty of the local nature. They immersed themselves in the warm waves of the ocean and enjoyed the fresh air. Every evening they watched the sunset as the sky was painted in fiery shades, and their hearts were filled with bliss and peace!

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

When they arrived at the picturesque island with white beaches and thick palm trees, the pirates felt, for the first time in years, that they no longer wanted to kill and plunder. From then on, they spent their days walking along the shore, enjoying the sunsets and sounds of the ocean, and gradually forgot about the worries and dangers of the pirate life. Yarr!

Suitable for the Tropical Atoll.

Can be obtained from Jack Cheap at the Tropical Atoll.

Hickut is no more, yet his children are sailing on. Silhouttes in the mist, the shades of those who drowned in the Cataclysm, guide them. They are looking for islands where the echo of Aether still resonates, and carry the sands of the canyon in their holds as the last trace of home.

Sources:

- Purchasing for currency  from Gerasim Rivin in the Faction Capital.

The finale of the story of the Order of the Crimson Wrath was sad - it split into the Red Legion and the Scarlet Army, who disagreed over who posed the greatest threat - demons or humans. Some found shelter in an ancient tower on a remote allod, others erected a new fortress - the Scarlet Bastion. But in the end, both parts of the Order eventually disappeared.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

While it's believed that the local gods are very difficult to kill, many of them were destroyed during Nezeb's invasion of Kania, when the Great Mages challenged those who came with the Emperor.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Blessed Leg Guards of the Brahman

description.en:
From the records of the Star Knights, it is known that one day a knight commander betrayed his overlord, and although the others remained loyal to him, the king was killed and the kingdom fell. Thus began a dark age, but one day the lost heir once again took his throne.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Summer 2022 ticket at the start of the event.

It's hard to imagine what drives not just a dead person, but the astral undead, a spawn of decay and chimerical illusions. They definitely need to be feared: the complete absence of those who survived such an encounter confirms that.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Those who genuinely accepted Hirkalla's rule are motivated by simple curiosity. What if the goddess of darkness is right, and the ancient interdicts no longer matter? If resurrection is a gift from Nihaz and not Tensess, shouldn't it be Nihaz they should praise?

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Spaulders of the Servant of Darkness

description.en:
The Order of the Sun has never had enmity with the Order of the Moon - the adepts of these organizations revered each other as brothers and sisters. But there was a third order - the Order of the Stars. Those monks were against everything the Great Mages stood for.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The modern Church reveres not only Tensess, Nezab, and Skrakan. There are also twelve Great Martyrs, along with those who became famous before the Night of the Astral Portals - for example, the adepts of the Order of the Moon.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Autumn 2023 ticket at the start of the event.

But the further he progressed in his mission, the more powerful the dark undead he fought became. In the final battle, the Inquisitor realized that his true strength lay not only in his faith, but also in his compassion for these creatures who had lost their humanity. He found a way to reconcile his faith with compassion, becoming a protector of both worlds.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

After a difficult battle with the ancient dragon, Velikogor felt that his strength was draining away. The wounds inflicted by the poisonous breath could not be healed. Realizing that his days were numbered, the hero gathered his loyal warriors one last time to give them his instructions and say goodbye. He urged them to always preserve the unity of the people of Aro and protect them from creatures like dragons.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

In the end Fedot betrayed the king and freed his bird maiden. Together they managed to leave the king's palace and return to their cozy home in the forest. They vowed never to follow someone else's orders again.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Despite all his efforts, Khitr was unable to find a way to return to earth from the moon. Days turned into years, and years into centuries, and he remained trapped in this strange world. Alone and desperate, he began to forget his past and his purpose. With each passing day, the magic of the moon became more and more powerful, and his mind began to disintegrate under its influence. Eventually, Khitr lost his identity, turning into a mad sorcerer.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

However, the prankster did not consider the consequences of his pranks. The local tribe chief declared that the ancient gods of the island cursed the prankster for his actions. The Waterfolk sealed him in a huge wooden barrel and set it afloat on the waves. After that, no one saw the famous prankster again.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

After defeating the Xadaganians and the traitor Nezeb, Kanian forces were faced with the unforeseen consequences of using necromancy. The resurrected Marksmen began to lose control over themselves. Their souls were captured by darkness, and their hearts turned to ice. The necromancer, consumed by his ambitions, could not stop the horror he had caused. The resurrected Marksmen turned on their allies, not distinguishing friend from foe. The bloody battle erupted with renewed vigor.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

For many years the bodies of the Marksmen rested on the battlefield, until the day came when the Ugra tribes, now called the Xadaganians, returned again. Needing new allies, a powerful necromancer in the service of the Valirs raised the Marksmen from their graves. And now the Marksmen have returned to the world of the living as the undead, ready to fight again for their homeland.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Ancient Legends ticket at the start of the event.

Regular demon hunters used alchemy to change their bodies, but monster hunters went much further. For them, nothing is forbidden and any means are justified when you fight evil. This made them outcasts, but their brotherhood is indestructible.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The main danger to astral transportation is not astral storms - an experienced captain can avoid them. And not astral demons - they are fierce and strong, but stupid and predictable. Only another captain, cunning and treacherous, is able to predict the actions of their colleague and set a trap for them.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

However, dragons weren't the only threat: vile creatures like trolls, jotunns, gremlins and gnomes also roamed the southern reaches of Egladien. And then the Velunds started a war. War for Beauty. Their guard became their punishing right hand, and the Silver Armor were their elite.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

The revived nobles were able to quickly understand the changes in fashion: after all, they were in line with their tastes, because Elven creations or items inspired by Elven aesthetics have always been and remain the most popular choice.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Only the bravest captains know the paths through the astral currents that can guide their ships through the most troubled sectors of the astral plane. They are called pirates of the dark astral plane, and few people dare to pursue their fast and nimble ships.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

After General Rabulion declared himself Emperor and led his armies into Kania, many Xadaganian nobles answered the call for help. Blood relatives came together on the battlefield - the most ancient Kanian nobility; their southern compatriots, torn off by conquest; and younger brothers who served the new ruler from the east.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Another ominous rumor speaks of a monstrous ship that was built from the skeleton of one of the first demons of Sarn. Instead of a wooden or iron frame, this vessel is assembled from bones and looks like an entire island inhabited by its own people.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Feint, Abordazh, Serebryankin - all these names have long been known. However, few people know who is part of the family of Maelstrom pirates. There are rumors that these are the surviving residents of the allods that died on the Night of Astral Portals.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Maelstrom Pirates ticket at the start of the event.

With each new discovery, Anempekht kept losing his grip on reality, descending into the abyss of abstract questions on existence and non-existence. He was wandering the streets, whispering spells that held no power anymore, and feeling his mind slowly come apart. In the end, the priest realized that the true plague is not the disease, but the lack of faith and reason for existing in the world that he was unable to comprehend.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Shoulderpads of the Priest of Forgotten Gods

description.en:
Summoning his strength, Ontuntakhm decided to use his knowledge and experience to combat the new evil that has engulfed mankind. He became a mysterious defender, striving to give the people some concept of morality and fearing the consequences of their actions. However, every step took him closer to realizing that even in his quest for atonement, he remained the part of the darkness that had once consumed him.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Upon realizing that war no longer required valor and honor, Nephersen decided to renounce his warrior's way. He became a teacher instead, sharing his knowledge of strategy and humanity in hopes of inspiring the new generation to forge the world without violence. Hope kindled in Nephersen's heart - hope that even in this altered world, a path to true glory might be found.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Despite falling into captivity, Shezmetet was not giving up hopes of breaking free and reclaiming her power. Using her ancient knowledge, she started whispering spells in the digital world, causing chaos among the hackers and awakening the powers that could not be suppressed. Over time, she was able to find alles among other spirits and creatures of technology that were ready to fight for their freedom.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

Having assembled a cohort of loyal followers, Tep told them of the grand purpose that Fate itself has put upon them - to become the lords of all worlds. The path to greatness, however, would be fraught with trials testing their dedication to the cause of the great necromancer. Yet every step would bring them closer to the power they were dreaming of.

Can be obtained during seasonal events.

name.en: Pauldrons of the Path of Tep Follower

description.en:
The Keepers started their journey across the allods, using their ancient skills and magic to find the tracks left behind by Tep and his followers. They found that the cult of Nih, now called Nihaz, was reborn, and its adepts were out to grab power, sowing fear and destruction in their wake. Warriors joined up with the defenders of the Allods, preparing for the final battle against the sinister Tep.

Can be received only as a reward for purchasing a Battle Campaign - Hickut's Legacy ticket at the start of the event.

name.en: Spaulders of the Keepers of the Forgotten Temple

description.en:
Reference from the Jeb-net: the Sekhem subculture offers its adepts the way of becoming free of societal stereotypes and expectations. Accepting diversity of expression and non-standard approach to outward appearance, they create a space where individuality is prized above mass tendencies.

Can be received from Sarang Pkhuta on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: Rutes find support and understanding in the communities of like-minded people who share their goals and interests. These groups become a venue for exchanging experiences and helping each other, which forges the sense of belonging and identity among their participants.

Can be received from Sarbaz Keket on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: the Yahkeb subculture also serves to counterbalance societal stereotypes of masculinity and toughness. Here, the acceptance of sensititivity and emotional depth is prevalent, which helps the space where both males and females can share their feelings without fear of disapproval.

Can be received from Yaver Leila on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: Munephs aim to forge strong ties to the society, using technology as means of increasing trust in police. Their aim is creating an open and transparent space where technologies serve the goal of protecting the interests of the citizenry and their security, as well as fostering dialogue between the police and the society as a whole.

Can be received from Nomarkh Khen on Xadagan.

Reference from the Jeb-net: archaeologists actively engage in seeking and extracting treasure, such as jewelry, statues and household items that might give clues about the daily life, religion and customs of the ancient Hickut. They desire not only to spotlight their activities and reward themselves for the effort undertaken, but also to make meaningful contributions to the science of archaeology, presenting valuable data for future research.

Can be received from Sarang Zuka on Xadagan.

The defenders of the Empire were not ordinary warriors. They were the best of the best, trained in combat, cunning strategies, and battle magic. The liberator warriors were ready to challenge any enemy that stood in their way. The battles they fought were fierce, but they did not lose heart and did not give up. They continued to fight until they liberated the lands from enemies.

Source: Glorious Victory Collector's Edition.

At a festive ball in Yasker's Tower, the test drivers were proclaimed heroes of the Empire. They won honorary awards and recognition. But most importantly, they earned the respect and admiration of their fellow citizens, becoming role models and a symbol of Xadaganian strength and spirit.

Source: Imperial Grandeur Collector's Edition.

The newest Zem project called the Wireframe is designed to embody the New Reality - a place where everything is possible and the boldest dreams might come to fruition. And no sacrifice is too great for its defenders.

Source: Eternal Struggle Collector's Edition.

These shoulder plates provide protection against the bites of Eden flora and fauna. Shoulders and lower back were the most vulnerable sites for injury reported by the first explorers of Eden. Injuries were often from the teeth of alien creatures.

Source: «Spring Winds» Collector's Edition.

The Sylvans do not build thrones. Their power is in the seeds that germinate on the allods where the priestess has set foot. Horns entwined in ivy show the path to the groves where their great Goddess whispers: "You are the roots from which the new world will sprout!"

Source: Spring's Tune Collector's Edition.

Sometimes it takes a miracle to prepare delicious food. And legendary chefs have it in stock: from enchanted kitchen utensils to a magical rat - everything is ready to help them create the next culinary masterpiece.

Source: Great Feast Prophetic Card.

It is a great honor to be a commissar of the special detachment created by Nezeb himself. Few Templars in the Trinity Church are worthy of this. Their loyalty to the Empire is unshakable.

Source: Nezeb's Precepts Prophetic Card.

The monks fought the lord of the Shadow Woods, and their faith became a bright Light that blinded the enemy. Each blow of the sword was imbued with sacred power, and prayers became a shield from evil spells. After a powerful blow, the dark lord fell, and his Darkness dissipated, and the Light and faith in it triumphed. Returning home as victors, the warrior monks knew that their faith was not just a weapon, but a life force capable of overcoming any obstacles. They set out on a new campaign, vowing to banish any Darkness.

Source: Holy Army Prophetic Card.

On this island, even household items were filled with lightbearing magic. Cups for drinking water were becoming a reason for a better mood, and favorite blankets were warming the spirit just as they were doing the body. When mixed together, the local fruits and berries were becoming the sweet treats that the craftspeople were generously giving to every newcomer.

Source: Elegant Patterns Prophetic Card.

His deafening whistle reaches every shore of the world and wakes up all living things from the winter sleep. It also brings along pouring rains and merciless hurricanes.

To coax the spirit, Priden shamans craft these talismans that can change the appearance of any mount in Sarnaut. This is a kind of joke Shri-Imp would love!
